name: Ring of Foolish Attempts
body:
Aura faint transmutation ; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of incredible deeds. Upon putting on the ring, the wearer suffers -2 penalty on all physical (Strength, Dexterity and Constitution)-based skill checks and saving throws.

This ring may only be removed by casting bull’s strength, bear’s endurance and cat’s grace upon it. Doing do renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of incredible deeds

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
